Initial release of ClawBuddy LiteKit

- Launch a live mission-control dashboard for OpenClaw AI agents.
- Monitor OpenClaw Gateway status, agent profiles, task boards, meetings, and multi-agent debates.
- Includes quick action scripts for dashboard access, status checks, and setup.
- Guides users through step-by-step OpenClaw integration.
- Focus on visual agent monitoring and streamlined setup.
